examples.en: His aggressive attitude tends to frighten other people away.
examples.zh: 他那咄咄逼人的态度总是把别人吓跑。

examples.en: Don't put up too many rules, or you'll frighten other people away.
examples.zh: 别立太多规矩，不然会把别人都吓走的。
